title: RollbackPlan
description: The plan to undo a promotion by moving the active pointer back — and ONLY the pointer. The lossless law's rollback gate: rollback_target_id is the version the pointer reverts to; from_artifact_id is the currently-promoted candidate that the pointer moves away from but is NEVER deleted (deletes_artifacts MUST be false, deletes_prior_responses MUST be false). Executing the plan writes a rollback receipt (rollback_receipt_id). Tenant-scoped: a rollback for tenant A only touches tenant A's pointer.

artifact_key.description: the logical key whose current pointer will move

from_artifact_id.description: the promoted candidate the pointer moves AWAY from; kept, never deleted

rollback_target_id.description: the version the pointer reverts to (the prior active version)

deletes_artifacts.description: MUST be false — rollback moves the pointer only, never deletes the promoted candidate

deletes_prior_responses.description: MUST be false — prior consumed responses stay readable after rollback

reason.description: why rollback (e.g. monitoring red, handle-leak, stale-served)

rollback_receipt_id.description: the receipt written when the plan executes
